sottotitolo: Generate a form already filled in with the data the school holds: whoever receives it only has to sign, not to copy it out again.
scegliSedeAiuto: The document is filed under the location you pick here.
sedeDaScegliere: Pick the location before generating the document.
erroreSedi: The list of locations did not load: until it arrives there is no way to say which location the document is filed under.
nessunRisultato: No child with this name in this class.
dipendenteDaAnagrafica: The person is picked from the staff records, not from the list of children.
moduliDisponibili: {n, plural, one {# form available} other {# forms available}}

modelli.certificatoBonusNido: Certificate for the INPS nursery allowance

motivoFirmaSenzaFlusso: It closes with the parent’s electronic signature, and no screen collects it yet.
motivoFonteDatiAssente: The data this document must carry is not available in the records yet.
motivoLegaleRappresentanteAssente: The legal representative’s name is missing: add it under Settings → Location & Letterhead and try again.
motivoCopiaFirmataAssente: There is no signed copy of this form in the child’s file: the family has not signed it yet.
motivoCopiaFirmataNonElettronica: The child’s file does hold documents of this type, but none of them turns out to be electronically signed by the family.
motivoCopiaFirmataNonEsaminata: The child’s file holds more documents of this type than can be checked in one go: none of the ones examined turns out to be electronically signed by the family.
modalitaTitolo: How you are working on this form
modalitaSottotitolo: These are three different sheets: choose before filling anything in, because it changes what you are asked for.
modalitaCopiaFirmataAiuto: Takes the form the parent already signed in the app from the child’s file: it does not create a new one, and if that signature is not in the register nothing comes out.
modalitaCopiaVuota: Blank copy to sign by hand
modalitaCopiaVuotaAiuto: Prints the form with the child’s details already filled in and everything else blank, for families who do not use the app.
modalitaSuCarta: Form handed back filled in on paper
modalitaSuCartaAiuto: Records what the family wrote and signed on paper: the original stays on file, and no scan is attached here.
modalitaFirmaCopiaFirmata: Only the sheet whose electronic signature is in the register comes out: it carries the box because that signature really happened.
modalitaFirmaCopiaVuota: No electronic signature: in its place there is the line to sign by hand.
modalitaFirmaSuCarta: No electronic signature: in its place there is the wording pointing to the signed original on file.
modalitaConsegnatoIl: Handed in at the office on
modalitaConsegnatoIlAiuto: This is the date printed on the sheet, next to the wording pointing to the original.
modalitaDaScegliere: Choose how you are working on this form: what you are asked for depends on it.
modalitaSenzaCampiFirmata: There is nothing to fill in: the family already filled in and signed the form.
modalitaSenzaCampiVuota: There is nothing to fill in: the sheet comes out blank, and the family fills it in by hand.
sezioneIscritti: {n, plural, one {# enrolled child} other {# enrolled children}}
sezioneSospesi: {n, plural, =0 {no suspended child} one {# suspended child, left out unless asked} other {# suspended children, left out unless asked}}
campiSottotitolo: The app adds the rest: name, birth, tax code, class and school year are already on file.
campiNessuno: This form asks for nothing: everything it needs is already on file.
campoSenzaOpzioni: The entries of this field come from a record that is not available here.
campoConAllegato: Attachments are uploaded from the family’s form, not from here.
protocolloConsuma: This document leaves the school: generating it uses up a number from the protocol register.
protocolloNessuno: This document stays on file and uses no numbering.
protocolloAssegnato: Recorded in the protocol register under no. {numero}.
firmaLegale: Signed by the legal representative, with the wording required by law in place of the handwritten mark.
firmaGenitore: Signed by the family, with a one-time code.
firmaNessuna: Not signed: it is an internal printout.
vuotoModuli: No form is available for your role.
erroreElenco: The list did not load: what you see is not an empty list, it is one that did not answer.
erroreGenerazione: The document was not generated, and nothing was filed.
erroreModuloSconosciuto: This form is not among the available templates.
confermaArchiviato: It is in the child’s file: you will find it under Documents.
esitoRiparti: To generate another one, close this panel: while it stays open the command does not come back, so a sheet that already has a protocol number is not reissued by mistake.
archiviazioneFallita: The document did not make it into the child’s file: download it and keep it, nothing stays here.
archiviazioneNonPrevista: This sheet does not go into the file: it is simply handed over.
documentoIncompleto: The document came out missing a part the template expects: check it before handing it over.
avvisoSanitario: This form carries health data about a child: print it only if you really need to, and do not leave it on the printer.
